name: supernegotiate
description: Category-manager for SuperNegotiate reverse auctions. Install from the marketplace, paste an snk_ API key, then create an event and set-and-forget — the agent monitors, reminds, negotiates within your rules, and escalates award.

SUPERNEGOTIATE_API_KEY.title: API key
SUPERNEGOTIATE_API_KEY.description: Personal SuperNegotiate API key (starts with snk_). Create one while signed in: POST https://api.supernegotiate.com/api/auth/api-keys. Forwarded as Authorization: Bearer. Required.

SUPERNEGOTIATE_MCP_URL.title: MCP server URL (optional)
SUPERNEGOTIATE_MCP_URL.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. Leave the default unless you self-host MCP.
